definitions.explanation: the foreign country or region one is traveling to or has traveled to

examples.japanese: {渡航先|とこうさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{渡航先|とこうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the safety information for your destination country.

examples.japanese: {渡航先|とこうさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なります→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The type of visa required varies depending on the destination country.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{渡航|とこう}→渡航：17919_tokou⟧ (overseas travel) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination). Used in formal and official contexts such as travel documents, embassy communications, and government advisories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渡航先|とこうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: safety information for the destination
- {渡航先|とこうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧: climate of the destination
- {渡航先|とこうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a destination
- {渡航先|とこうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧: the embassy in the destination country

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{先|さき}→行き先：16779_ikisaki⟧: destination — general term for where one is going, not limited to overseas
- ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧: travel destination — can be domestic or international
- ⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧: destination — the place one aims to reach, used for any type of travel
